chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Hassan al-Razi from Muhammad ibn from Muhammad ibn Ali, he raised it (to the Prophet), he said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Whoever prays at night, his face will be beautiful by day.'
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of praying at night according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith underscores the transformative power of *Salat al-Layl*, linking nocturnal devotion to a visible spiritual radiance (*husn al-wajh*) by day. In Shia tradition, this 'beauty' is understood not merely as physical attractiveness but as the manifestation of inner light (*nur*) and tranquility resulting from consistent communion with the Divine.
